definitions.gloss: temporary closure; closed day (of a facility)
definitions.explanation: A scheduled or temporary closure of a public facility such as a library, museum, or sports center, typically for a regular day off, maintenance, or special circumstances.

examples.japanese: ⟦{月曜日|げつようび}→月曜日：00624_getsuyoubi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{休館|きゅうかん}です。
{休館日|きゅうかんび}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{出|で}かけた→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: You should check the closed days before heading out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{設備|せつび}→設備：03301_setsubi⟧⟦{点検|てんけん}→点検：09765_tenken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{三日間|みっかかん}{休館|きゅうかん}となります。
examples.english: The facility will be closed for three days next week for equipment inspection.

notes:
{休館|きゅうかん} means the temporary closure of a public facility such as a library, museum, or community hall.

USAGE:
- Functions as a ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb and as a noun.
- Always implies a temporary period of being closed — not permanent shutdown.
- The compound {休館日|きゅうかんび} (closed day) appears constantly on signs and websites for public facilities.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {休館|きゅうかん}{日|び}: closed day (the most common compound; many museums close on Mondays)
- ⟦{本日|ほんじつ}→本日：09643_honjitsu⟧{休館|きゅうかん}: 'closed today'
- ⟦{臨時|りんじ}→臨時：04092_rinji⟧{休館|きゅうかん}: special/temporary closure (outside the regular schedule)
- ⟦{改装|かいそう}→改装：09682_kaisou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧{休館|きゅうかん}⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧: closed for renovations
- ⟦{年末年始|ねんまつねんし}→年末年始：12457_nenmatsunenshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{休館|きゅうかん}⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧: closed during the New Year holidays

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{閉館|へいかん}→閉館：18858_heikan⟧: 'closing' (can mean the daily closing time, or — in serious cases — permanent closure of a facility).
- ⟦{定休日|ていきゅうび}→定休日：09541_teikyuubi⟧: regular closing day (the equivalent term for shops and restaurants).
- ⟦{臨時|りんじ}{休業|きゅうぎょう}→臨時休業：17041_rinjikyuugyou⟧: temporary closure of a business.
